decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The level of noise from the plant shall be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receptor. The level of noise emitted from the plant shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing noise levels (Laeq) when measured over any 24 hour period from the nearest noise sensitive receptor.
description: Variation of condition 2 requiring the development to be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals and plans submitted of planning permission 00248/D8+9/P1 for  amendments to the approved details of buildings 8 (00248/D/P53) dated 15/08/2006 to allow reduction of height from five to four stories, reduction in height of the louvre canopy, increased storage/workshop/plant area at undercroft area and reduction in car parking.
